title: Keyturn Vehicle Listing: Setting the Daily Price a Host Asks
content:
What a host asks per day for their own Keyturn Vehicle Listing is set on the listing itself. One entry rewrites the daily price carried on that listing; nothing else about the vehicle moves, and bookings already confirmed keep the price locked in at their own confirmation. Afterwards the host sees the new daily price on the listing, and guests searching the marketplace are quoted from it.

### Making the entry

The price is the host's own to set. The desk unlocks the customer-side tool `set_daily_price_59fd8a00` and hands it over, and it is run by the customer themselves. One run sets one price.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vehicle_id` | The listing reference number of the host's own vehicle whose price is being set | Taken from what the desk has read back from the vehicle listing lookup |
| `daily_price_amount` | The daily price the host asks from now on | In USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half away from zero at the point it is written; an amount of 0.00 means no price is asked |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the listing and the daily price now carried on it to 2 decimal places. A sentence naming the listing is what indicates the new price stands; a report that the listing could not be found means nothing was written.
